race.comment: MEAN APPROACH (1) opened this prep with a couple of wins at the midweekers then tired at the end of 1400m two Saturday's back at the Farm. Can improve back to his pet distance. SHELSTEIN (9) made nice progress last start at the second run of his campaign in a Class 3 over 1350m here. All three wins have come at 1200m so he must be considered. MISHANI MOET (7) carries no weight and is another who will enjoy coming back in trip. BONDED AFFAIR (2) runs here rather than later in the card and it looks a good move. He improved nicely last time out and now third-up he looks poised to strike from a good draw. Keep safe.
